title: Deselect pin drives camera_set_selection directly; the frame-loop selection-diff guard upstream of it remains unpinned
evidence:
main.odin:697-699 (the production deselect path):
		if app.input.sel_node != app.last_sel_node || app.input.sel_pipe != app.last_sel_pipe {
			camera_set_selection(&app)
		}
input/exec.odin:473-474 (the deselect itself only clears the selection):
		inp.sel_node = -1
		inp.sel_pipe = -1
The new test bypasses the guard: "camera_set_selection(&app) // nothing selected -> the deselect else-branch homes"
detail: In production a deselect reaches the :1800 homing only via the frame-loop diff guard; the test calls the proc directly. Deleting the guard breaks deselect-homing with the suite green. The PR's own claim (call-site wiring pinned) holds — I re-ran the mutation leg.
recommended_fix: Optionally pin the guard later: set sel/last_sel, clear sel, run one frame-loop tick (or extract the guard) so a guard removal also goes red. Out of this PR's B1 scope.
